package practiceroute

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/courseplan"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

var materialKeyPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

type Materializer struct {
	Routes    repository.PracticeLearningRouteRepository
	Catalog   repository.PracticeLearningCatalog
	Generator domainservice.ContentGenerator
	Courses   domainservice.CourseService
}

func (materializer Materializer) Ensure(
	ctx context.Context,
	idempotencyKey string,
	materialKey string,
	request domain.PracticeMaterialEnsureRequestV1,
) (domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1, error) {
	request.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(request.Schema)
	request.RouteID = strings.TrimSpace(request.RouteID)
	request.RouteDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(request.RouteDigest))
	materialKey = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(materialKey))
	if materializer.Routes == nil || materializer.Catalog == nil || materializer.Generator == nil || materializer.Courses == nil ||
		request.Schema != domain.PracticeMaterialEnsureRequestSchemaV1 || !materialKeyPattern.MatchString(materialKey) {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(request.RouteID); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	record, err := materializer.Routes.GetByID(ctx, request.RouteID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, err
	}
	if record.Route.RouteDigest != request.RouteDigest {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	material, found := findRouteMaterial(record.Route, materialKey)
	if !found || strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey) != material.GenerationKey {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	definitions, err := materializer.Catalog.ResolveDefinitions(ctx, []domain.TargetRef{material.Target})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, err
	}
	indexed, err := indexDefinitions([]domain.TargetRef{material.Target}, definitions)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, err
	}
	definition := indexed[domain.TargetIdentity(material.Target)]
	course, contextJSON, err := materialCoursePlan(material, definition)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, err
	}
	course, err = courseplan.GenerateCourseContent(ctx, materializer.Generator, material.GenerationKey, course, contextJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, err
	}
	ensured, err := materializer.Courses.EnsureCourse(ctx, course, material.GenerationKey)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, err
	}
	if len(ensured.Lessons) != 1 || len(ensured.Lessons[0].Targets) != 1 ||
		domain.TargetIdentity(ensured.Lessons[0].Targets[0]) != domain.TargetIdentity(material.Target) {
		return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return domain.PracticeMaterialResultV1{
		Schema: domain.PracticeMaterialResultSchemaV1, MaterialKey: material.Key, Target: material.Target,
		CourseID: ensured.CourseID, LessonID: ensured.Lessons[0].LessonID, Reused: ensured.Reused,
	}, nil
}

func findRouteMaterial(route domain.PracticeLearningRoute, key string) (domain.LearningMaterialRef, bool) {
	var result domain.LearningMaterialRef
	found := false
	for _, step := range route.Steps {
		for _, requirement := range step.Requirements {
			if requirement.Material == nil || requirement.Material.Key != key {
				continue
			}
			if found && !sameMaterialRef(result, *requirement.Material) {
				return domain.LearningMaterialRef{}, false
			}
			result, found = *requirement.Material, true
		}
	}
	return result, found
}

func sameMaterialRef(left, right domain.LearningMaterialRef) bool {
	leftJSON, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
	rightJSON, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
	return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftJSON) == string(rightJSON)
}

func materialCoursePlan(material domain.LearningMaterialRef, definition domain.LearningTargetDefinition) (domain.GeneratedCourse, json.RawMessage, error) {
	code := "practice-" + material.Key[:16]
	course := domain.GeneratedCourse{
		Fingerprint: material.Key, FingerprintVersion: material.FingerprintVersion,
		GoalCode: "practice-prerequisite", GoalVersion: "v1", Title: definition.Title,
		Description: definition.Description, Language: material.Locale,
		Status: domain.CourseStatusActiveBuilding, CatalogVisible: false,
		PlannerVersion: material.PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: material.PedagogyProfile,
		PresentationStyle: material.PresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: material.GenerationPolicy,
		Modules: []domain.PlannedModule{{
			Code: "practice", Title: "Practice prerequisites", Order: 0,
			Sections: []domain.PlannedSection{{
				Code: string(material.Target.Type), Title: "Required knowledge", Order: 0,
				Lessons: []domain.PlannedLesson{{
					Code: code, Title: definition.Title, Excerpt: definition.Description, Order: 0,
					Status: domain.LessonStatusPlanned, Targets: []domain.TargetRef{material.Target},
					Prerequisites:      append([]domain.TargetRef(nil), definition.Prerequisites...),
					PedagogyStrategies: append([]domain.PedagogyStrategyRef(nil), material.PedagogyStrategies...),
				}},
			}},
		}},
	}
	contextJSON, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"schema": "practice-learning-material-context.v1", "target": definition,
		"planner_version": material.PlannerVersion, "pedagogy_profile": material.PedagogyProfile,
		"presentation_style": material.PresentationStyle, "generation_policy": material.GenerationPolicy,
	})
	return course, contextJSON, err
}
